#### Interpretation and fitting of model remaining

```{r}
library(readr)
# data <- read_csv("C:/Users/Admin/Desktop/Nivedha/R/TS/exchange_rates.csv")
data=c(12,65,34,98,23,54,12,74,17,18,32)
```

```{r}
plot(data)
```


```{r}
model<-arima(data,order = c(1,0,1),method="ML")
model1<-arima(data,order = c(3,0,1),method="ML")
```

```{r}
print(model)
```

```{r}
print(model1)
```


```{r}

(AirPassengers)
```

```{r}
ts_data<-ts(AirPassengers,frequency = 1)
```



```{r}

model_1
```
